capability: Owner-configured Linux systemd reload attestation using the existing Control Plane request, receipt and activation state machine; durable single dispatch and observation-only reconciliation.

resolvedGateFailure.cause: The fixture pinned the environment shared Node interpreter with nlink=2; the production descriptor contract correctly requires one link. The origin of the extra link was not established.
resolvedGateFailure.fix: Tests copy the native Node interpreter into a private single-link temporary directory and remove it after the suite. Production validation is unchanged.

rootCheck.sourceCoverage: Final root gate includes final production code and private-interpreter test fixture fix. The optional real DSH E2E mode was added after gate startup and verified by direct execution and final focused lint. Documentation and evidence were finalized after the gate.

supervisorFixtures.scope: Actual systemd user service with idle Node process; run precedes the optional real DSH fixture mode, uses the same final attestor bytes.

Actual DSH 0.1.5-rc.2 shipped Web template in a unique temporary home/profile and transient user service, with invocation-bound startup markers before and after reload; no candidate plugin or model call.

baseCommitCi.scope: Previous capability only; does not replace this commit CI.

independentReview.selectionLimit: Native verifier/worker activation was unavailable because the agent thread limit was reached; the existing independent explorer performed read-only verification.
scope: Read-only review of exact request authorization, descriptor pins, installation-wide generation, durable single dispatch, crash/lost-ack reconciliation and cgroup boundaries.
Independent final source/evidence hashes, both actual supervisor fixture modes, full root gate log and Control Plane dry-run package contents verification.

limits: Only the reload phase is implemented. The receipt advances to awaiting-readiness; active systemd state or a Web startup marker does not prove candidate Fiber readiness or behavior.

The request is unsigned. A separately provisioned owner-private configuration authorizes its exact digest, scope, generation and validity. Candidate/model authority does not provision this configuration.
Mode checks do not isolate hostile processes sharing the same UID. Independent supervisor identity and protected state remain owner responsibilities.
Observation is not atomic against another administrator and does not establish causal attribution to a particular systemd job.
An already accepted restart cannot be revoked by killing the helper. A systemctl child can survive attestor death; external supervisor/cgroup containment is required for that boundary.

Profile pins cover declared configuration inputs, not every loaded dependency. No production npm publication, production Host activation, complete WP16/WP18 cycle or cross-task improvement is claimed.
